full_judgment: 16. Mr Ramzan Ali Khan, the learned Counsel for the defendant opposite parties, submits that the rent receipt of the defendants although are many in number, but the same were manufactured by forgery by the defendants to grab the suit land although they have no title or possession in the same. Defendants could not show payment of rent of the period from the years 1934-1943, 1945-46, 1950-52 and for the years 1976-87 which also destroys the case of the defendants that they paid rent for all the years from 1930, the alleged years of taking pattan of the suit land by them. Preparation of SA or ROR Khatian and payment of the rent does not create any title in favour of the defendants when the plaintiffs could prove their possession as well, in the suit land.
